research_scope: Rough Ranger — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.history_search: No duplicate skill identity found in the reviewed repository research history.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms Rough Ranger as a Strike Super and a Universal Counter Skill.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: PQ119 — A Ranger's Duty is the repository-linked acquisition source. Dragon Ball Wiki explicitly states Ultimate Finish; a Steam PQ guide presents Rough Ranger in the displayed reward list without the same UF annotation, so the discrepancy is preserved rather than hidden.
verification_audit.finish_finding: Ultimate Finish remains the repository's supported acquisition interpretation based on Dragon Ball Wiki plus existing repository audit/history.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Rough Ranger is associated with Android 17 (DB Super) and Extra Pack 2.
verification_audit.cost_finding: Current reviewed skill documentation lists 100 Ki; stamina cost remains unresolved.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The universal counter branches by incoming attack: Strike/basic attacks produce a kick, while Ki-based attacks produce the barrier, with point-blank Ki Blast treated as the kick case.
verification_audit.method: Revalidated identity, combat resource, counter behavior, DLC/character provenance, and PQ crosslinks while explicitly preserving the acquisition-source discrepancy.

records.name: Rough Ranger
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: Dragon Ball Wiki explicitly states Future Warrior acquisition from PQ119 via Ultimate Finish; repository skill-catalog audit and Batch 215 preserve the same interpretation. A Steam PQ guide lists Rough Ranger in its displayed reward set without annotating the condition, so the source discrepancy is retained.
records.skill_description: Brace for an incoming attack. Ki-based attacks are answered with a barrier, while Strike attacks and point-blank Ki Blasts are answered with a kick.
records.mechanics_notes: Universal counter. Strike/basic attacks trigger the kick response; Ki-based attacks trigger the barrier, while point-blank Ki Blast is documented as the kick case. Exact frames/hitboxes remain unresolved.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ119 — A Ranger's Duty. Ultimate Finish is the repository-supported condition, with an explicit note that one Steam reward guide presents the skill in the displayed reward list without the UF annotation.
records.pve_notes: The counter's split response makes its trigger behavior dependent on attack type and distance.
records.pvp_notes: Community reports corroborate the universal-counter behavior and the point-blank Ki Blast exception; exact frame data remains unverified.
